# Northwind Telecom — Refund policy

*Synthetic document. Northwind Telecom is a fictional operator invented for testing; every figure
below is made up and describes no real product, tariff or person.*

## Scope

This policy covers amounts paid to Northwind Telecom for prepaid packs, postpaid rent, fibre rent,
installation and equipment. It does not cover third-party content subscriptions bought through the
app, which are governed by the content provider's own terms.

## Prepaid packs

A pack is refundable in full if no data, call or message has been carried on it. Once any traffic has
been carried, the pack is not refundable, because validity has begun. A pack applied to the wrong
number is refunded in full if reported within 24 hours.

## Postpaid rent

Rent is not refunded for a cycle that has begun. When a connection closes mid-cycle, the closing
bill is prorated by whole days and any credit balance is returned within 21 working days.

## Fibre installation

The installation charge is refunded in full if the line cannot be provisioned after the visit. It is
not refunded once the line is live, even if the connection is closed shortly afterwards.

## Equipment

A router or mesh node is lent, not sold, so there is nothing to refund. The non-return charge is
reversed in full if the equipment is returned within 90 days of being billed.

## How a refund is paid

A refund goes back to the instrument it came from. A card payment is reversed to the same card, a
UPI payment to the same handle, a cash payment as a credit on the account or, if the account is
closed, by bank transfer to an account in the customer's name.

## How long a refund takes

Up to 7 working days for a prepaid pack, up to 21 working days for a postpaid credit balance, and up
to 21 working days for an installation charge. The clock starts when the refund is approved, not when
it is requested.

## What is never refunded

Amounts already consumed, late fees correctly levied, charges under an open dispute that is decided
against the customer, and government levies collected on the operator's behalf.
